name: Alpha Partner USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Alpha Partners' BSC-only dollar token whose backing is described only as protocol-managed collateral and liquidity reserves; mechanism opaque.
collateral: Alpha Partners protocol collateral and managed liquidity reserves on BSC
pegMechanism: Protocol-managed dollar token using collateral reserves and incentive mechanisms to support the peg

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: Alpha Partners' USDA is a BSC ERC-20 whose verified contract exposes a role-gated mint() callable only by holders of a MINT role, with role-based admin controls for minting, blacklisting and tax parameters and no on-chain supply cap; the backing mechanism is otherwise undocumented.

controls.label: USDA MINT role holder
controls.capDescription: Contract has no maximum supply cap; addresses granted the MINT role can issue USDA without an on-chain limit.
controls.evidence: The verified USDA token contract on BscScan exposes a mint() function restricted to a MINT role and role-based admin controls (mint, blacklist, tax ratios) with no supply cap, read from the BscScan contract page.

review.evidence: BscScan verified-source for the USDA token shows a role-gated mint() (MINT role) plus role-based blacklist and tax administration with no supply cap; project docs do not describe collateral/redemption mechanics, so the on-chain role-gated mint is the established authority path.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Role-gated mint confirmed from the verified BscScan contract; the specific role-holder address/operator identity was not resolved and the collateral/backing process is undocumented in project materials.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve which address(es) hold the MINT role and the role admin, and whether any off-chain reserve actually backs issued supply.
